2607.21233.title: Logic Programming Semantics for Causal Processes
2607.21233.paper_summary: Motivated by challenging modelling issues in the life sciences, we investigate the relationship between logic programming semantics and the eventual states of causal processes compatible with those logic programs. More precisely, we show that while stable models of positive logic programs correspond to the eventual states of processes commencing from a neutral state and continuing undisturbed indefinitely, supported models describe the eventual states reachable from arbitrary starting points. This also contributes to the discussion of the appropriate semantics for logic programming as a causal rule language, adding a temporal perspective to recent interpretations of the stable and supported model semantics from an explanatory viewpoint of causality.
2607.21233.paper_summary_zh: 受到生命科學中挑戰性建模問題的激勵，我們調查邏輯程式語義與與這些邏輯程式相容的因果過程的最終狀態之間的關係。<lb/>更精確地說，我們顯示，雖然正邏輯程式的穩定模型對應於從中立狀態開始並持續不受干擾的過程的最終狀態，但支持模型描述的是從任意起始點可達的最終狀態。<lb/>這也有助於討論邏輯程式作為因果規則語言的適當語義，並為最近從因果性解釋角度對穩定和支持模型語義的詮釋增添了一個時間視角。
2607.21233.author: Felix Weitkämper et.al.
